functions.snippetHtml:
static bool valid_name(const char *name) {
  if (!name || !name[0] || strlen(name) > 47)
    return false;
  for (const char *c = name; *c; c++)
    if (!(*c >= 'a' && *c <= 'z') && !(*c >= '0' && *c <= '9') && *c != '-')
      return false;
  return true;
}

functions.name: acds_protocol_create
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_protocol_create(acds_protocol_t *p, const acds_session_create_params_t *params,
                                       uint8_t total_keys, uint8_t key_index) {
  if (!p || !params)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid discovery create parameters");
  if (params->reserved_string && params->reserved_string[0])
    return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED, "Reserved session names are not supported", true);
  acip_session_create_t req = {0};
  memcpy(req.identity_pubkey, params->identity_pubkey, sizeof(req.identity_pubkey));
  req.timestamp = time_ns_to_ms(time_get_realtime_ns());
  req.capabilities = params->capabilities;
  req.max_participants = params->max_participants;
  req.session_type = params->session_type;
  req.total_keys = total_keys;
  req.key_index = key_index;
  req.has_password = params->has_password;
  req.expose_ip_publicly = params->acds_expose_ip;
  SAFE_STRNCPY(req.server_address, params->server_address, sizeof(req.server_address));
  req.server_port = params->server_port;
  asciichat_error_t result = acds_sign_session_create(params->identity_seckey, req.timestamp, req.capabilities,
                                                      req.max_participants, req.signature);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    return protocol_fail(p, result, "Could not sign session creation", true);
  if (params->has_password &&
      crypto_pwhash_str((char *)req.password_hash, params->password,
                        strnlen(params->password, sizeof(params->password)), crypto_pwhash_OPSLIMIT_INTERACTIVE,
                        crypto_pwhash_MEMLIMIT_INTERACTIVE) != 0)
    return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_CRYPTO, "Could not hash session password", true);
  p->state = ACDS_CREATING;
  result = protocol_send(p, PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_CREATE, &req, sizeof(req));
  sodium_memzero(&req, sizeof(req));
  return result;
}

functions.name: acds_protocol_lookup
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_protocol_lookup(acds_protocol_t *p, const char *name) {
  if (!p)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing discovery protocol");
  if (!valid_name(name))
    return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid session name", true);
  acip_session_lookup_t req = {0};
  req.session_string_len = (uint8_t)strlen(name);
  memcpy(req.session_string, name, req.session_string_len);
  SAFE_STRNCPY(p->name, name, sizeof(p->name));
  p->state = ACDS_LOOKING_UP;
  return protocol_send(p, PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_LOOKUP, &req, sizeof(req));
}

functions.name: acds_protocol_join
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_protocol_join(acds_protocol_t *p, const acds_session_join_params_t *params) {
  if (!p || !params)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid discovery join parameters");
  if (!valid_name(params->session_string))
    return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid session name", true);
  acip_session_join_t req = {0};
  req.session_string_len = (uint8_t)strlen(params->session_string);
  memcpy(req.session_string, params->session_string, req.session_string_len);
  memcpy(req.identity_pubkey, params->identity_pubkey, sizeof(req.identity_pubkey));
  req.timestamp = time_ns_to_ms(time_get_realtime_ns());
  req.has_password = params->has_password;
  if (params->has_password)
    SAFE_STRNCPY(req.password, params->password, sizeof(req.password));
  asciichat_error_t result =
      acds_sign_session_join(params->identity_seckey, req.timestamp, params->session_string, req.signature);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    return protocol_fail(p, result, "Could not sign session join", true);
  p->state = ACDS_JOINING;
  result = protocol_send(p, PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_JOIN, &req, sizeof(req));
  sodium_memzero(&req, sizeof(req));
  return result;
}

functions.name: acds_protocol_enter
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_protocol_enter(acds_protocol_t *p, bool create, const char *name, const char *password) {
  if (!p || !password)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid discovery parameters");
  if (strlen(password) > 127)
    return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Password is too long", true);
  if (crypto_sign_keypair(p->join.identity_pubkey, p->join.identity_seckey) != 0)
    return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_CRYPTO, "Could not generate discovery identity", true);
  p->auto_join = true;
  p->require_webrtc = true;
  p->join.has_password = password[0] != 0;
  SAFE_STRNCPY(p->join.password, password, sizeof(p->join.password));
  p->join.session_string = p->name;
  if (!create)
    return acds_protocol_lookup(p, name);
  acds_session_create_params_t params = {.capabilities = 3,
                                         .max_participants = PARTICIPANT_LIMIT,
                                         .session_type = SESSION_TYPE_WEBRTC,
                                         .has_password = p->join.has_password};
  memcpy(params.identity_pubkey, p->join.identity_pubkey, sizeof(params.identity_pubkey));
  memcpy(params.identity_seckey, p->join.identity_seckey, sizeof(params.identity_seckey));
  memcpy(params.password, p->join.password, sizeof(params.password));
  asciichat_error_t result = acds_protocol_create(p, &params, 0, 0);
  sodium_memzero(&params, sizeof(params));
  return result;
}

functions.name: acds_protocol_receive
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_protocol_receive(acds_protocol_t *p, packet_type_t type, const void *payload, size_t length) {
  if (!p || (!payload && length))
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid discovery packet");
  if (p->state == ACDS_FAILED || p->state == ACDS_ENDED)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_STATE, "Discovery session has ended");
  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_ERROR || type == PACKET_TYPE_ERROR_MESSAGE) {
    asciichat_error_t result = network_error_decode(type, payload, length);
    return protocol_fail(p, result, asciichat_error_string(result), true);
  }
  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_END) {
    p->state = ACDS_ENDED;
    p->terminal = true;
    SAFE_STRNCPY(p->error, "Session ended", sizeof(p->error));
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Session ended");
  }
  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_CREATED && p->state == ACDS_CREATING) {
    if (length < sizeof(p->created))
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Truncated created session", true);
    memcpy(&p->created, payload, sizeof(p->created));
    if (!p->created.session_string_len || p->created.session_string_len > 47)
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Invalid created session name", true);
    memcpy(p->name, p->created.session_string, p->created.session_string_len);
    p->name[p->created.session_string_len] = 0;
    p->state = ACDS_CREATED;
    if (p->auto_join)
      return acds_protocol_join(p, &p->join);
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }
  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_INFO && p->state == ACDS_LOOKING_UP) {
    if (length < sizeof(p->info))
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Truncated session information", true);
    memcpy(&p->info, payload, sizeof(p->info));
    p->state = ACDS_FOUND;
    if (!p->auto_join)
      return ASCIICHAT_OK;
    if (!p->info.found)
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NETWORK, "Session not found", true);
    if (p->require_webrtc && p->info.session_type != SESSION_TYPE_WEBRTC)
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED, "This session does not offer WebRTC", true);
    if (p->info.require_server_verify || p->info.require_client_verify)
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED, "This session requires an authorized identity", true);
    if (p->info.has_password && !p->join.has_password)
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_CRYPTO_AUTH, "This session requires a password", true);
    return acds_protocol_join(p, &p->join);
  }
  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_JOINED && p->state == ACDS_JOINING) {
    if (length < sizeof(p->joined))
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Truncated discovery join response", true);
    memcpy(&p->joined, payload, sizeof(p->joined));
    p->joined.error_message[sizeof(p->joined.error_message) - 1] = 0;
    p->joined.server_address[sizeof(p->joined.server_address) - 1] = 0;
    p->joined.turn_username[sizeof(p->joined.turn_username) - 1] = 0;
    p->joined.turn_password[sizeof(p->joined.turn_password) - 1] = 0;
    if (!p->joined.success)
      return protocol_fail(p, network_error_from_acip(p->joined.error_code),
                           p->joined.error_message[0] ? p->joined.error_message : "Session join rejected", true);
    if (p->require_webrtc && p->joined.session_type != SESSION_TYPE_WEBRTC)
      return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED, "This session does not offer WebRTC", true);
    p->state = ACDS_JOINED;
    sodium_memzero(p->join.identity_seckey, sizeof(p->join.identity_seckey));
    sodium_memzero(p->join.password, sizeof(p->join.password));
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }
  // Signaling and participant notifications are delivered by the caller's transport adapter.
  if (p->state == ACDS_JOINED && type != PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_CREATED && type != PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_INFO &&
      type != PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_SESSION_JOINED)
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  return protocol_fail(p, ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Unexpected discovery response", true);
}

functions.name: acds_protocol_leave

asciichat_error_t acds_protocol_leave(acds_protocol_t *p) {
  if (!p)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing discovery protocol");
  if (p->state != ACDS_JOINED)
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;

}

functions.name: acds_handshake_receive
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_handshake_receive(crypto_handshake_context_t *ctx, acip_transport_t *transport,
                                         packet_type_t type, const void *payload, size_t length) {
  if (!ctx || !transport || (!payload && length))
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid handshake packet");
  switch (type) {
  case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_PARAMETERS:
    if (ctx->state != CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_INIT || length != sizeof(crypto_parameters_packet_t))
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Invalid discovery crypto parameters");
    if ((((const crypto_parameters_packet_t *)payload)->selected_cipher != CIPHER_ALGO_NONE) !=
        ctx->crypto_ctx.encrypt_data)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Discovery server changed requested encryption");
    return crypto_handshake_set_parameters(ctx, payload);
  case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_KEY_EXCHANGE_INIT:
    return crypto_handshake_client_key_exchange(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
  case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_AUTH_CHALLENGE:
    return crypto_handshake_client_auth_response(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
  case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_COMPLETE:
  case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_SERVER_AUTH_RESP:
  case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_AUTH_FAILED:
    return crypto_handshake_client_complete(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
  default:
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Unexpected discovery handshake packet: %u", type);
  }
}

functions.name: acds_receive_packet
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_receive_packet(acip_transport_t *transport, packet_type_t *type, void **payload, size_t *length,
                                      void **allocation) {
  asciichat_error_t result = packet_receive_via_transport(transport, type, payload, length, allocation);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK || acip_transport_get_type(transport) != ACIP_TRANSPORT_WEBSOCKET ||
      !transport->crypto_ctx || !transport->crypto_ctx->encrypt_data)
    return result;
  if (*type != PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Discovery signaling requires encrypted packets");
  packet_envelope_t envelope = {.type = *type, .data = *payload, .len = *length, .allocated_buffer = *allocation};
  result = packet_decrypt_envelope(&envelope, transport->crypto_ctx);
  *allocation = envelope.allocated_buffer;
  *type = envelope.type;
  *payload = envelope.data;
  *length = envelope.len;
  if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    const packet_header_t *inner = envelope.allocated_buffer;
    if (NET_TO_HOST_U64(inner->magic) != PACKET_MAGIC || envelope.type == PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED ||
        asciichat_crc32(envelope.data, envelope.len) != NET_TO_HOST_U32(inner->crc32))
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Invalid encrypted discovery packet");
  }
  return result;
}

functions.name: acds_client_handshake
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t acds_client_handshake(acds_client_t *client) {
  asciichat_error_t result = crypto_handshake_init("acds_client", &client->handshake_ctx, false);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    return result;
  crypto_policy_t policy = client->config.security_policy;
  policy.transport_secure = false; // This connector opens TCP.
  if (client->config.identity_key && client->config.identity_key[0]) {
    result = parse_private_key(client->config.identity_key, &client->handshake_ctx.client_private_key);
    if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
      return result;
    client->handshake_ctx.client_public_key.type = KEY_TYPE_ED25519;
    memcpy(client->handshake_ctx.client_public_key.key, client->handshake_ctx.client_private_key.public_key,
           sizeof(client->handshake_ctx.client_private_key.public_key));
    policy.has_identity = true;
  }
  uint8_t mode;
  result = crypto_policy_resolve(&policy, &mode);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    return result;
  client->handshake_ctx.crypto_ctx.encrypt_data = ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(mode);
  result = acds_handshake_begin(client->transport, mode);
  if (mode == ACIP_CRYPTO_NONE)
    return result;
  while (result == ASCIICHAT_OK && client->handshake_ctx.state != CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_READY) {
    packet_type_t type;
    void *payload = NULL, *allocation = NULL;
    size_t length = 0;
    result = packet_receive_via_transport(client->transport, &type, &payload, &length, &allocation);
    if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK)
      result = acds_handshake_receive(&client->handshake_ctx, client->transport, type, payload, length);
    buffer_release(allocation);
  }
  if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK)
    client->transport->crypto_ctx = &client->handshake_ctx.crypto_ctx;
  return result;
}

functions.name: acds_client_connect
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acds_client_connect(acds_client_t *client, const acds_client_config_t *config) {
  if (!client || !config) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "client or config is NULL");
  }

  memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
  memcpy(&client->config, config, sizeof(acds_client_config_t));
  client->socket = INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE;
  client->connected = false;

  // Resolve server address (supports both hostnames and IP addresses, IPv4 and IPv6)
  struct addrinfo hints;
  struct addrinfo *result = NULL;
  memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
  hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;     // IPv4 or IPv6
  hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM; // TCP

  char port_str[16];
  safe_snprintf(port_str, sizeof(port_str), "%d", config->server_port);

  log_debug("ACDS: Resolving address '%s:%s'...", config->server_address, port_str);
  int gai_result = getaddrinfo(config->server_address, port_str, &hints, &result);
  if (gai_result != 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Failed to resolve server address '%s': %s", config->server_address,
                     gai_strerror(gai_result));
  }
  log_debug("ACDS: Address resolved successfully");
  freeaddrinfo(result);

  // Use parallel_connect to attempt IPv4 and IPv6 connections concurrently
  parallel_connect_config_t pconn_config = {
      .hostname = config->server_address,
      .port = config->server_port,
      .timeout_ms = config->timeout_ms,
      .should_exit_callback = config->should_exit_callback,
      .callback_data = config->callback_data,
  };

  asciichat_error_t pconn_result = parallel_connect(&pconn_config, &client->socket);
  if (pconn_result == ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    client->connected = true;

    client->transport = acip_tcp_transport_create("acds_client_transport", client->socket, NULL);
    if (!client->transport) {
      socket_close(client->socket);
      client->socket = INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE;
      client->connected = false;
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Failed to create ACDS transport");
    }

    asciichat_error_t handshake_result = acds_client_handshake(client);
    if (handshake_result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
      acip_transport_destroy(client->transport);
      client->transport = NULL;
      socket_close(client->socket);
      client->socket = INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE;
      client->connected = false;
      return handshake_result;
    }

    /* Register ACDS client with named registry */
    char acds_name[64];
    snprintf(acds_name, sizeof(acds_name), "acds_client:%s:%d", config->server_address, config->server_port);
    NAMED_REGISTER(client, acds_name, "acds_client_t", "0x%tx", NULL);

    log_info("Connected to ACDS server at %s:%d", config->server_address, config->server_port);
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  return pconn_result;
}

functions.name: acds_client_disconnect
functions.snippetHtml:
void acds_client_disconnect(acds_client_t *client) {
  if (!client) {
    return;
  }

  if (client->socket != INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE) {
    if (client->transport) {
      acip_transport_destroy(client->transport);
      client->transport = NULL;
    }
    crypto_handshake_destroy(&client->handshake_ctx);
    socket_close(client->socket);
    client->socket = INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE;
  }

  client->connected = false;
  log_debug("Disconnected from ACDS server");
}

asciichat_error_t acds_session_create(acds_client_t *client, const acds_session_create_params_t *params,
                                      acds_session_create_result_t *result) {
  if (!client || !client->connected || !params || !result)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid discovery create parameters");
  acds_protocol_t protocol;
  acds_protocol_init(&protocol, client_protocol_send, client);
  asciichat_error_t error = acds_protocol_create(&protocol, params, 0, 0);
  if (error == ASCIICHAT_OK)
    error = client_protocol_receive(client, &protocol);
  if (error == ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result));
    SAFE_STRNCPY(result->session_string, protocol.name, sizeof(result->session_string));
    memcpy(result->session_id, protocol.created.session_id, sizeof(result->session_id));
    result->expires_at = protocol.created.expires_at;
  }
  acds_protocol_destroy(&protocol);
  return error;
}

asciichat_error_t acds_session_lookup(acds_client_t *client, const char *name, acds_session_lookup_result_t *result) {
  if (!client || !client->connected || !name || !result)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid discovery lookup parameters");
  acds_protocol_t protocol;
  acds_protocol_init(&protocol, client_protocol_send, client);
  asciichat_error_t error = acds_protocol_lookup(&protocol, name);
  if (error == ASCIICHAT_OK)
    error = client_protocol_receive(client, &protocol);
  if (error == ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result));
    result->found = protocol.info.found;
    if (result->found) {
      memcpy(result->session_id, protocol.info.session_id, sizeof(result->session_id));
      memcpy(result->host_pubkey, protocol.info.host_pubkey, sizeof(result->host_pubkey));
      result->capabilities = protocol.info.capabilities;
      result->max_participants = protocol.info.max_participants;
      result->current_participants = protocol.info.current_participants;
      result->has_password = protocol.info.has_password;
      result->created_at = protocol.info.created_at;
      result->expires_at = protocol.info.expires_at;
      result->require_server_verify = protocol.info.require_server_verify;
      result->require_client_verify = protocol.info.require_client_verify;
    }
  }
  acds_protocol_destroy(&protocol);
  return error;
}

    memcpy(result->session_id, protocol.joined.session_id, sizeof(result->session_id));
    result->session_type = protocol.joined.session_type;

functions.name: acds_handler_hash_lookup
functions.snippetHtml:
static inline int acds_handler_hash_lookup(const acds_hash_entry_t *table, packet_type_t type) {
  uint32_t h = ACDS_HASH(type);
  for (int i = 0; i < ACDS_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
    uint32_t slot = (h + i) % ACDS_HASH_SIZE;
    if (table[slot].key == 0)
      return -1;
    if (table[slot].key == type)
      return table[slot].handler_idx;
  }
  return -1;
}

functions.name: acip_handle_acds_packet
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_handle_acds_packet(acip_transport_t *transport, packet_type_t type, const void *payload,
                                          size_t payload_len, const char *client_ip,
                                          const acip_acds_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  stats_runtime_packet(transport ? transport->stats_peer : NULL, type, payload_len, false, true);
  if (!callbacks) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid callbacks");
  }

  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_NETWORK_QUALITY) {
    log_debug_every(US_PER_SEC_INT,
                    "★ ACIP_HANDLE_ACDS_PACKET: Dispatching type=%u (NETWORK_QUALITY) from %s, payload_len=%zu", type,
                    client_ip, payload_len);
  }

  if ((unsigned)type == CONSENSUS_HANDOFF_PACKET) {
    if (!callbacks->on_handoff)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_STATE, "Handoff unsupported");
    return callbacks->on_handoff(payload, payload_len, transport, callbacks->app_ctx);
  }

  // O(1) dispatch via hash table lookup
  int idx = acds_handler_hash_lookup(g_acds_handler_hash, type);
  if (idx < 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Unhandled ACDS packet type: %d from %s", type, client_ip);
  }

  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_NETWORK_QUALITY) {
    log_debug_every(US_PER_SEC_INT, "★ ACIP_HANDLE_ACDS_PACKET: Found handler at index=%d", idx);
  }

  uint64_t stats_start = time_get_ns();
  asciichat_error_t result = g_acds_handlers[idx](payload, payload_len, transport, client_ip, callbacks);
  stats_duration_record(stats_runtime_scope(), STATS_DURATION_REQUEST, time_get_ns() - stats_start);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    stats_counter_add(stats_runtime_scope(), STATS_COUNTER_REQUEST_FAILURES, 1);
  return result;
}

functions.name: handle_acds_session_create
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t handle_acds_session_create(const void *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                                    acip_transport_t *transport, const char *client_ip,
                                                    const acip_acds_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  if (!callbacks->on_session_create) {
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  if (payload_len < sizeof(acip_session_create_t)) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "SESSION_CREATE payload too small from %s", client_ip);
  }

  const acip_session_create_t *req = (const acip_session_create_t *)payload;

  // Multi-key protocol: validate parameters only for first key (key_index == 0)
  // total_keys > 0 indicates multi-key mode; skip validation for subsequent keys
  if (req->key_index == 0 || req->total_keys == 0) {
    // Validate session parameters for first key or single-key mode
    if (req->max_participants == 0 || req->max_participants > PARTICIPANT_LIMIT) {
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid max_participants: %u from %s (expected: 1-128)",
                       req->max_participants, client_ip);
    }

    if (req->session_type > 1) {
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid session_type: %u from %s (expected: 0=DIRECT_TCP or 1=WEBRTC)",
                       req->session_type, client_ip);
    }

    // Validate server port (0 = system assigned, 1-65535 = valid)
    // Allow 0 for auto-assignment during WEBRTC mode
    if (req->session_type == 0 && req->server_port == 0) {
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "DIRECT_TCP session requires valid server_port from %s", client_ip);
    }
  }

  callbacks->on_session_create(req, transport, client_ip, callbacks->app_ctx);
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_server_validate_session_create
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_server_validate_session_create(const acip_session_create_t *req) {
  if (!req) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Session create request is NULL");
  }

  // Validate capabilities (only bits 0-1 should be set)
  if (req->capabilities & ~0x03) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid capabilities bits (only 0-1 allowed)");
  }

  // Validate max_participants (1-128)
  if (req->max_participants < 1 || req->max_participants > PARTICIPANT_LIMIT) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid max_participants (must be 1-128)");
  }

  // Server address can be empty - ACDS will auto-detect from connection source IP

  // Validate server port is non-zero
  if (req->server_port == 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Server port is zero");
  }

  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_server_validate_session_join
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_server_validate_session_join(const acip_session_join_t *req) {
  if (!req) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Session join request is NULL");
  }

  // Validate session string length
  if (req->session_string_len == 0 || req->session_string_len > ACIP_MAX_SESSION_STRING_LEN) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid session string length");
  }

  // Validate session string is not empty
  if (req->session_string[0] == '\0') {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Session string is empty");
  }

  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_server_send_error
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_server_send_error(socket_t sockfd, acip_error_code_t error_code, const char *error_message) {
  if (sockfd == INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid socket");
  }

  if (!error_message) {
    error_message = "Unknown error";
  }

  acip_error_t error_packet;
  memset(&error_packet, 0, sizeof(error_packet));
  error_packet.error_code = (uint8_t)error_code;

  // Safely copy error message (truncate if needed)
  size_t msg_len = strlen(error_message);
  if (msg_len >= sizeof(error_packet.error_message)) {
    msg_len = sizeof(error_packet.error_message) - 1;
  }
  memcpy(error_packet.error_message, error_message, msg_len);
  error_packet.error_message[msg_len] = '\0';

  // Send ACIP_ERROR packet
  int result = send_packet(sockfd, PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_ERROR, &error_packet, sizeof(error_packet));
  if (result < 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Failed to send ACIP error packet");
  }

  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

static outbound_stream_t *stream_state(acip_outbound_t *out, uint16_t type, uint32_t id) {
  for (size_t i = 0; i < out->stream_count; ++i)
    if (out->streams[i].type == type && out->streams[i].stream == id)
      return &out->streams[i];
  if (out->stream_count == OUTBOUND_MAX_STREAMS)
    return NULL;
  outbound_stream_t *stream = &out->streams[out->stream_count++];
  *stream = (outbound_stream_t){.type = type, .stream = id, .needs_keyframe = true};
  return stream;
}

functions.name: discard_stream
functions.snippetHtml:
static void discard_stream(acip_outbound_t *out, const outbound_packet_t *video) {
  if (video->encoded) {
    outbound_stream_t *stream = stream_state(out, video->type, video->stream);
    if (stream)
      stream->needs_keyframe = true;
  }
  outbound_packet_t **link = &out->head;
  while (*link) {
    outbound_packet_t *packet = *link;
    if (packet->video && same_stream(packet, video)) {
      *link = packet->next;
      out->bytes -= packet->cost;
      --out->count;
      ++out->stats.dropped;
      packet_free(packet);
    } else {
      link = &packet->next;
    }
  }
}

functions.name: expire_video
functions.snippetHtml:
static void expire_video(acip_outbound_t *out, uint64_t now) {
  for (;;) {
    outbound_packet_t *expired = NULL;
    for (outbound_packet_t *p = out->head; p; p = p->next)
      if (p->video && now - p->created > ACIP_OUTBOUND_VIDEO_AGE_NS) {
        expired = p;
        break;
      }
    if (!expired)
      break;
    outbound_packet_t identity = *expired;
    discard_stream(out, &identity);
  }
}

functions.name: fail_queue
functions.snippetHtml:
static void fail_queue(acip_outbound_t *out) {
  out->failed = true;
  while (out->head) {
    outbound_packet_t *p = out->head;
    out->head = p->next;
    out->bytes -= p->cost;
    --out->count;
    if (p->wait) {
      p->result = ERROR_NETWORK;
      p->done = true;
    } else {
      packet_free(p);
    }
  }
  cond_broadcast(&out->changed);
}

functions.name: outbound_worker
functions.snippetHtml:
static void *outbound_worker(void *arg) {
  acip_outbound_t *out = arg;
  mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
  while (!out->stopping && !out->failed) {
    uint64_t now = time_get_ns();
    expire_video(out, now);
    outbound_packet_t *p = out->head;
    if (!p) {
      cond_wait(&out->changed, &out->mutex);
      continue;
    }
    /* Admitted reliable traffic expires by closing the connection, never by
     * silently removing an audio or control packet. */
    uint64_t deadline = p->audio ? 5 * NS_PER_SEC_INT : 10 * NS_PER_SEC_INT;
    if (!p->video && now - p->created > deadline) {
      fail_queue(out);
      break;
    }
    size_t backend = backend_bytes(out);
    // Keep scheduling decisions in the plaintext queue. Even tiny reliable
    // packets must not accumulate behind video in a backend's opaque FIFO.
    if (backend != 0) {
      cond_timedwait(&out->changed, &out->mutex, 2 * NS_PER_MS_INT);
      continue;
    }
    out->head = p->next;
    out->bytes -= p->cost;
    // Admission reserves plaintext plus two wire owners. During handoff one
    // wire owner moves into the backend's counter, so do not count it twice.
    out->active_bytes = p->cost - (p->size + WIRE_OVERHEAD);
    mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
    /* One worker fixes wire/encryption order. Backends receive only complete
     * packets and must finish a partially submitted packet or fail the stream. */
    asciichat_errno_scope_t scope = asciichat_errno_scope_begin();
    asciichat_error_t result = out->transport->methods->send(out->transport, p->data, p->size);
    asciichat_errno_scope_end(scope, ASCIICHAT_ERRNO_HANDLED);
    mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
    out->active_bytes = 0;
    --out->count;
    if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK) {
      ++out->stats.submitted;
      if (p->encoded && p->keyframe)
        ++out->stats.recovery_frames;
    }
    if (p->wait) {
      p->result = result;
      p->done = true;
    } else {
      packet_free(p);
    }
    cond_broadcast(&out->changed);
    if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
      fail_queue(out);
      break;
    }
  }
  bool failed = out->failed;
  mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
  if (failed)
    out->transport->methods->close(out->transport);
  return NULL;
}

functions.name: acip_outbound_create
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_outbound_create(acip_transport_t *transport) {
  if (!transport || !transport->methods || !transport->methods->send)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing outbound backend");
  if (transport->outbound)
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  acip_outbound_t *out = SAFE_CALLOC(1, sizeof(*out), acip_outbound_t *);
  if (mutex_init(&out->mutex, "outbound") != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    SAFE_FREE(out);
    return GET_ERRNO();
  }
  if (cond_init(&out->changed, "outbound_changed") != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    mutex_destroy(&out->mutex);
    SAFE_FREE(out);
    return GET_ERRNO();
  }
  out->transport = transport;
  asciichat_error_t result = asciichat_thread_create(&out->worker, "outbound", outbound_worker, out);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    cond_destroy(&out->changed);
    mutex_destroy(&out->mutex);
    SAFE_FREE(out);
    return result;
  }
  transport->outbound = out;
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_outbound_destroy
functions.snippetHtml:
void acip_outbound_destroy(acip_transport_t *transport) {
  acip_outbound_t *out = transport->outbound;
  if (!out)
    return;
  mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
  out->stopping = true;
  cond_broadcast(&out->changed);
  mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
  /* The caller has quiesced producers. Interrupt a blocking legacy TCP write
   * before joining, while every backend resource is still alive. */
  transport->methods->close(transport);
  asciichat_thread_join(&out->worker, NULL);
  mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
  fail_queue(out);
  mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
  cond_destroy(&out->changed);
  mutex_destroy(&out->mutex);
  SAFE_FREE(transport->outbound);
}

functions.name: acip_outbound_submitv
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_outbound_submitv(acip_transport_t *transport, const socket_buffer_t *buffers, size_t count,
                                        acip_admission_t *admission) {
  if (!transport || !transport->outbound || !buffers || !count || count > SOCKET_IOV_MAX || !admission)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid outbound submission");
  *admission = ACIP_ADMISSION_CONGESTED;
  size_t size = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
    if ((buffers[i].len && !buffers[i].data) || buffers[i].len > ACIP_OUTBOUND_BUDGET - WIRE_OVERHEAD - size)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_SIZE, "Outbound packet exceeds byte budget");
    size += buffers[i].len;
  }
  packet_header_t header;
  if (buffers[0].len < sizeof(header))
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing outbound ACIP header");
  memcpy(&header, buffers[0].data, sizeof(header));
  outbound_packet_t info = {.size = size,
                            .cost = 3 * (size + WIRE_OVERHEAD) + sizeof(outbound_packet_t) + 128,
                            .type = NET_TO_HOST_U16(header.type),
                            .stream = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.client_id)};
  info.encoded = info.type == PACKET_TYPE_IMAGE_FRAME_H264 || info.type == PACKET_TYPE_IMAGE_FRAME_H265;
  info.video = info.encoded || info.type == PACKET_TYPE_IMAGE_FRAME || info.type == PACKET_TYPE_ASCII_FRAME;
  info.audio = info.type == PACKET_TYPE_AUDIO_BATCH || info.type == PACKET_TYPE_AUDIO_OPUS_BATCH;
  info.wait = !info.video && !info.audio && info.type != PACKET_TYPE_PING && info.type != PACKET_TYPE_PONG;
  if (info.encoded) {
    const uint8_t *flags = NULL;
    if (buffers[0].len > sizeof(header))
      flags = (const uint8_t *)buffers[0].data + sizeof(header);
    else if (count > 1 && buffers[1].len)
      flags = buffers[1].data;
    if (!flags)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_FRAME, "Missing encoded frame flags");
    info.keyframe = (*flags & 1) != 0;
  }
  acip_outbound_t *out = transport->outbound;
  mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
  info.created = time_get_ns();
  if (out->stopping || out->failed) {
    mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Outbound connection closed");
  }
  expire_video(out, info.created);
  outbound_stream_t *stream = info.encoded ? stream_state(out, info.type, info.stream) : NULL;
  if (info.encoded && (!stream || (stream->needs_keyframe && !info.keyframe))) {
    ++out->stats.dropped;
    *admission = ACIP_ADMISSION_NEEDS_KEYFRAME;
    mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }
  if (info.video && !info.encoded)
    discard_stream(out, &info);
  size_t backend = backend_bytes(out);
  size_t reserved = info.video   ? ACIP_OUTBOUND_CONTROL_RESERVE + ACIP_OUTBOUND_AUDIO_RESERVE
                    : info.audio ? ACIP_OUTBOUND_CONTROL_RESERVE
                                 : 0;
  size_t limit = ACIP_OUTBOUND_BUDGET - reserved;
  size_t pending = out->bytes + out->active_bytes + backend + transport->methods->reserved_bytes;
  if (out->count >= OUTBOUND_MAX_PACKETS - (info.video   ? 64
                                            : info.audio ? 32
                                                         : 0) ||
      pending > limit || info.cost > limit - pending) {
    if (info.encoded)
      discard_stream(out, &info);
    ++out->stats.congestion;
    mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }
  outbound_packet_t *p = SAFE_MALLOC(sizeof(*p), outbound_packet_t *);
  *p = info;
  p->data = buffer_alloc(info.wait ? buffer_control_domain() : NULL, size);
  if (!p->data) {
    SAFE_FREE(p);
    mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Cannot own outbound plaintext");
  }
  size_t offset = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
    if (buffers[i].len)
      memcpy(p->data + offset, buffers[i].data, buffers[i].len);
    offset += buffers[i].len;
  }
  /* Audio and ping/pong may bypass whole unsent video. Other controls remain
   * FIFO barriers (stream setup/teardown and negotiation cannot be reordered). */
  bool priority = info.audio || info.type == PACKET_TYPE_PING || info.type == PACKET_TYPE_PONG;
  outbound_packet_t **link = &out->head;
  if (priority) {
    // Do not move audio or liveness traffic across an earlier protocol barrier.
    for (outbound_packet_t **scan = &out->head; *scan; scan = &(*scan)->next)
      if (!(*scan)->video && !(*scan)->audio && (*scan)->type != PACKET_TYPE_PING && (*scan)->type != PACKET_TYPE_PONG)
        link = &(*scan)->next;
  }
  while (*link && (!priority || !(*link)->video))
    link = &(*link)->next;
  p->next = *link;
  *link = p;
  out->bytes += info.cost;
  ++out->count;
  ++out->stats.accepted;
  pending += info.cost;
  if (pending > out->stats.peak_bytes)
    out->stats.peak_bytes = pending;
  if (stream && info.keyframe)
    stream->needs_keyframe = false;
  *admission = ACIP_ADMISSION_ACCEPTED;
  cond_broadcast(&out->changed);
  asciichat_error_t result = ASCIICHAT_OK;
  if (info.wait) {
    while (!p->done)
      cond_wait(&out->changed, &out->mutex);
    result = p->result;
    packet_free(p);
  }
  mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
  return result == ASCIICHAT_OK ? result : SET_ERRNO(result, "Outbound submission failed");
}

functions.name: acip_outbound_snapshot
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_outbound_snapshot(acip_transport_t *transport, acip_outbound_stats_t *stats) {
  if (!transport || !transport->outbound || !stats)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing outbound statistics");
  acip_outbound_t *out = transport->outbound;
  mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
  *stats = out->stats;
  stats->application_bytes = out->bytes + out->active_bytes;
  stats->backend_bytes = backend_bytes(out);
  stats->backend_reserved_bytes = transport->methods->reserved_bytes;
  uint64_t now = time_get_ns();
  for (outbound_packet_t *p = out->head; p; p = p->next)
    if (p->video && now - p->created > stats->oldest_frame_age_ns)
      stats->oldest_frame_age_ns = now - p->created;
  mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_outbound_needs_keyframe
functions.snippetHtml:
bool acip_outbound_needs_keyframe(acip_transport_t *transport, uint16_t type, uint32_t id) {
  if (!transport || !transport->outbound)
    return false;
  acip_outbound_t *out = transport->outbound;
  mutex_lock(&out->mutex);
  outbound_stream_t *stream = stream_state(out, type, id);
  bool needed = !stream || stream->needs_keyframe;
  mutex_unlock(&out->mutex);
  return needed;
}

functions.name: acip_client_receive_and_dispatch
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_client_receive_and_dispatch(acip_transport_t *transport,
                                                   const acip_client_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  if (!transport || !callbacks) {
    log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ INVALID_PARAMS: transport=%p, callbacks=%p", (void *)transport, (void *)callbacks);
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid transport or callbacks");
  }

  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 📥 RECV_START: transport=%p, checking connection state", (void *)transport);

  // Check if transport is connected
  if (!transport->methods->is_connected(transport)) {
    log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ NOT_CONNECTED: transport not ready for receive");
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Transport not connected");
  }

  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] ✅ CONNECTED: transport ready, checking transport type");

  packet_envelope_t envelope;
  bool enforce_encryption = (transport->crypto_ctx != NULL);
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 🔐 CRYPTO_MODE: enforce_encryption=%s", enforce_encryption ? "yes" : "no");

  socket_t sock = transport->methods->get_socket(transport);
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 🔌 TRANSPORT_SOCKET: socket=%d (INVALID=%d)", sock, INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE);

  void *packet_data = NULL;
  void *allocated_buffer = NULL;
  size_t packet_len = 0;

  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 📥 RECV_CALL: using transport->methods->recv()");
  asciichat_error_t recv_result = acip_transport_recv(transport, &packet_data, &packet_len, &allocated_buffer);
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 📥 RECV_RESULT: error=%d, packet_len=%zu, data=%p, alloc=%p", recv_result, packet_len,
            packet_data, allocated_buffer);

  if (recv_result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    if (recv_result == ERROR_NETWORK_TIMEOUT) {
      log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] Receive timed out while waiting for signaling data");
    } else {
      stats_runtime_packet(transport->stats_peer, 0, 0, false, false);
      log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ RECV_FAILED: error code %d", recv_result);
    }
    return recv_result;
  }

  // Parse packet header
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] HEADER_CHECK: packet_len=%zu, header_size=%zu", packet_len, sizeof(packet_header_t));
  if (packet_len < sizeof(packet_header_t)) {
    log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ HEADER_TOO_SMALL: %zu < %zu", packet_len, sizeof(packet_header_t));
    buffer_release(allocated_buffer);
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Packet too small: %zu < %zu", packet_len, sizeof(packet_header_t));
  }

  const packet_header_t *header = (const packet_header_t *)packet_data;
  envelope.type = NET_TO_HOST_U16(header->type);
  envelope.len = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header->length);
  envelope.data = (uint8_t *)packet_data + sizeof(packet_header_t);
  envelope.allocated_buffer = allocated_buffer;
  envelope.allocated_size = packet_len;
  envelope.was_encrypted = false;

  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] HEADER_PARSED: type=%u (0x%04x), len=%u, total_size=%zu", envelope.type, envelope.type,
            envelope.len, packet_len);

  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "ACIP received packet: type=%u, len=%u, total_size=%zu", envelope.type,
                envelope.len, packet_len);

  // Validate packet length
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] LENGTH_VALIDATION: payload_size=%u vs actual=%zu", envelope.len,
            packet_len - sizeof(packet_header_t));
  if (envelope.len != packet_len - sizeof(packet_header_t)) {
    log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ LENGTH_MISMATCH: header=%u, actual=%zu", envelope.len,
              packet_len - sizeof(packet_header_t));
    buffer_release(allocated_buffer);
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Packet length mismatch: header says %u, actual %zu", envelope.len,
                     packet_len - sizeof(packet_header_t));
  }

  // Handle PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED from server (decrypt and extract inner packet)
  if (envelope.type == PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED) {
    log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 🔐 ENCRYPTED_PACKET: decrypting PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED (len=%u)", envelope.len);
    asciichat_error_t decrypt_result = packet_decrypt_envelope(&envelope, transport->crypto_ctx);
    if (decrypt_result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
      log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ DECRYPT_FAILED: %d", decrypt_result);
      buffer_release(envelope.allocated_buffer);
      return decrypt_result;
    }
  }

  // Dispatch packet to appropriate ACIP handler
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 🎯 DISPATCH_START: type=%u (0x%04x), data_len=%u, callbacks=%p", envelope.type, envelope.type,
            envelope.len, (void *)callbacks);
  asciichat_error_t dispatch_result =
      acip_handle_client_packet(transport, envelope.type, envelope.data, envelope.len, callbacks);

  if (dispatch_result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    log_error("[ACIP_RECV] ❌ DISPATCH_FAILED: type=%u, error=%d", envelope.type, dispatch_result);
  } else {
    log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] ✅ DISPATCH_OK: type=%u (0x%04x) handled by callbacks", envelope.type, envelope.type);
  }

  // Always free the allocated buffer (even if handler failed)
  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] 🗑️  CLEANUP: freeing buffer %p (size=%zu)", envelope.allocated_buffer, envelope.allocated_size);
  if (envelope.allocated_buffer) {
    buffer_release(envelope.allocated_buffer);
  }

  log_debug("[ACIP_RECV] ✅ RECV_COMPLETE: type=%u, result=%d", envelope.type,
            dispatch_result != ASCIICHAT_OK ? -1 : 0);

  // Return handler result
  return dispatch_result;
}

functions.name: acip_send_image_frame
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_send_image_frame(acip_transport_t *transport, const void *pixel_data, uint32_t width,
                                        uint32_t height, uint32_t pixel_format) {
  log_dev("★ ACIP_SEND_IMAGE_FRAME: Called with %ux%u, transport=%p, pixel_data=%p", width, height, (void *)transport,
          pixel_data);

  if (!transport || !pixel_data) {
    log_dev("★ ACIP_SEND_IMAGE_FRAME: Invalid params");
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid transport or pixel_data");
  }

  // Calculate pixel data size (3 bytes per pixel for RGB24)
  size_t pixel_size = (size_t)width * height * 3;
  log_dev("★ ACIP_SEND_IMAGE_FRAME: pixel_size=%zu", pixel_size);

  // Create image frame packet header
  image_frame_packet_t header;
  header.width = HOST_TO_NET_U32(width);
  header.height = HOST_TO_NET_U32(height);
  header.pixel_format = HOST_TO_NET_U32(pixel_format);
  header.compressed_size = 0;
  header.checksum = 0;
  header.timestamp = 0;

  socket_buffer_t slices[] = {{&header, sizeof(header)}, {pixel_data, pixel_size}};
  return packet_send_via_transportv(transport, PACKET_TYPE_IMAGE_FRAME, slices, 2, 0);
}

functions.name: acip_send_image_frame_h265
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_send_image_frame_h265(acip_transport_t *transport, h265_encoder_t *encoder,
                                             const void *pixel_data, uint32_t width, uint32_t height) {
  if (!transport || !encoder || !pixel_data) {
    log_debug("★ ACIP_SEND_IMAGE_FRAME_H265: Invalid params");
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid transport, encoder, or pixel_data");
  }

  // Allocate output buffer for H.265 encoding
  // H.265 can produce output larger than input due to codec overhead
  // Use 2x multiplier to account for worst-case frame content
  size_t output_buffer_size = 5 + (width * height * 2);
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_1] About to allocate output buffer (%zu bytes)", output_buffer_size);
  uint8_t *output_buffer = buffer_alloc(NULL, output_buffer_size);
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_2] ✅ Allocated output buffer");
  if (!output_buffer) {
    log_debug("★ ACIP_SEND_IMAGE_FRAME_H265: Failed to allocate output buffer");
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Failed to allocate H.265 output buffer: %zu bytes", output_buffer_size);
  }

  // Admission expiry can invalidate a previously accepted reference chain.
#ifndef __EMSCRIPTEN__
  if (acip_outbound_needs_keyframe(transport, PACKET_TYPE_IMAGE_FRAME_H265, 0))
    h265_encoder_request_keyframe(encoder);
#endif
  size_t encoded_size = output_buffer_size;
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_3] Calling h265_encode");
  asciichat_error_t encode_result = h265_encode(encoder, (uint16_t)width, (uint16_t)height, (const uint8_t *)pixel_data,
                                                output_buffer, &encoded_size);
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_4] h265_encode returned: %d, encoded_size=%zu", encode_result, encoded_size);

  if (encode_result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    log_error("H.265 encoding failed: %s", asciichat_error_string(encode_result));
    buffer_release(output_buffer);
    return encode_result;
  }

  // h265_encode includes flags, dimensions, and the encoded picture already.
  size_t total_size = encoded_size;
  if (!total_size) {
    buffer_release(output_buffer);
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  log_debug("★ ACIP_SEND_IMAGE_FRAME_H265: Encoded %ux%u → %zu bytes", width, height, total_size);

  // Send via transport
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_5] Calling packet_send_via_transport with %zu bytes", total_size);
  asciichat_error_t result =
      packet_send_via_transport(transport, PACKET_TYPE_IMAGE_FRAME_H265, output_buffer, total_size, 0);
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_6] packet_send_via_transport returned: %d", result);

  buffer_release(output_buffer);
  log_dev("[ACIP_SEND_H265_7] ✅ Freed output buffer, returning from acip_send_image_frame_h265");
  return result;
}

asciichat_error_t acip_send_stream_stop(acip_transport_t *transport, uint8_t stream_types) {
  if (!transport) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid transport");
  }

  // Server expects uint32_t (4 bytes), not uint8_t
  uint32_t stream_types_net = HOST_TO_NET_U32((uint32_t)stream_types);
  return packet_send_via_transport(transport, PACKET_TYPE_STREAM_STOP, &stream_types_net, sizeof(stream_types_net), 0);
}

functions.name: handler_hash_lookup
functions.snippetHtml:
static inline int handler_hash_lookup(const handler_hash_entry_t *table, packet_type_t type) {
  uint32_t h = HANDLER_HASH(type);
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "HANDLER_HASH_LOOKUP: type=%d, hash=%u", type, h);
  for (int i = 0; i < HANDLER_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
    uint32_t slot = (h + i) % HANDLER_HASH_SIZE;
    log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "  Checking slot %u: key=%d, handler_idx=%d", slot, table[slot].key,
                  table[slot].handler_idx);
    // Match found - return handler index immediately
    if (table[slot].key == type) {
      log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "  Found match at slot %u, handler_idx=%d", slot, table[slot].handler_idx);
      return table[slot].handler_idx;
    }
    // NOTE: Do NOT return on empty slot! Hash table can have gaps due to collision chains.
    // Continue probing through entire table to find the key.
  }
  log_debug("  No match found after scanning all %u slots", HANDLER_HASH_SIZE);
  return -1; // Not found after checking all slots
}

functions.name: acip_handle_client_packet
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_handle_client_packet(acip_transport_t *transport, packet_type_t type, const void *payload,
                                            size_t payload_len, const acip_client_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  stats_runtime_packet(transport ? transport->stats_peer : NULL, type, payload_len, false, true);
  if (!transport || !callbacks) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid transport or callbacks");
  }
  (void)transport;

  // ACDS broadcasts participant lifecycle notifications to peers. The generic
  // client callback set does not expose them, so ignore them while keeping the
  // signaling receive loop alive for subsequent SDP and ICE packets.
  if (type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_PARTICIPANT_JOINED || type == PACKET_TYPE_ACIP_PARTICIPANT_LEFT) {
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  // O(1) dispatch via hash table lookup
  int idx = handler_hash_lookup(g_client_handler_hash, type);
  if (idx < 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Unhandled client packet type: %d", type);
  }

  return g_client_handlers[idx](payload, payload_len, callbacks);
}

functions.name: handle_client_ascii_frame
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t handle_client_ascii_frame(const void *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                                   const acip_client_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  if (!callbacks->on_ascii_frame) {
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  if (payload_len < sizeof(ascii_frame_packet_t)) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "ASCII_FRAME payload too small");
  }

  // Extract header
  ascii_frame_packet_t header;
  memcpy(&header, payload, sizeof(header));

  // Convert from network byte order
  header.width = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.width);
  header.height = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.height);
  header.original_size = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.original_size);
  header.compressed_size = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.compressed_size);
  header.checksum = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.checksum);
  header.flags = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.flags);

  // Get frame data (after header)
  const void *frame_data = (const uint8_t *)payload + sizeof(ascii_frame_packet_t);
  size_t frame_data_len = payload_len - sizeof(ascii_frame_packet_t);

  // Validate frame dimensions to prevent DoS and buffer overflow attacks
  if (header.width == 0 || header.height == 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid frame dimensions: %ux%u (width and height must be > 0)",
                     header.width, header.height);
  }

  // Sanity check: prevent unreasonably large frames (e.g., > 16K resolution)
  // This protects against resource exhaustion attacks
  const uint32_t MAX_WIDTH = 16384;  // 16K
  const uint32_t MAX_HEIGHT = 16384; // 16K
  if (header.width > MAX_WIDTH || header.height > MAX_HEIGHT) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Frame dimensions too large: %ux%u (max: %ux%u)", header.width, header.height,
                     MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);
  }

  callbacks->on_ascii_frame(&header, frame_data, frame_data_len, callbacks->app_ctx);
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: handle_client_audio_batch
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t handle_client_audio_batch(const void *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                                   const acip_client_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  if (!callbacks->on_audio_batch) {
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  if (payload_len < sizeof(audio_batch_packet_t)) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "AUDIO_BATCH payload too small");
  }

  // Parse batch header
  const audio_batch_packet_t *batch_header = (const audio_batch_packet_t *)payload;
  uint32_t batch_count = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->batch_count);
  uint32_t total_samples = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->total_samples);
  uint32_t sample_rate = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->sample_rate);
  uint32_t channels = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->channels);

  // Validate sample rate and channels
  // Supported sample rates: 8000, 16000, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000, 96000, 192000 Hz
  if (sample_rate == 0 || (sample_rate < 8000 || sample_rate > 192000) ||
      (sample_rate != 8000 && sample_rate != 16000 && sample_rate != 24000 && sample_rate != 32000 &&
       sample_rate != 44100 && sample_rate != 48000 && sample_rate != 96000 && sample_rate != 192000)) {
    return SET_ERRNO(
        ERROR_INVALID_PARAM,
        "Invalid audio sample rate: %u Hz (expected: 8000, 16000, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000, 96000, or 192000)",
        sample_rate);
  }

  // Validate channel count (1-8 channels supported)
  if (channels == 0 || channels > 8) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid audio channel count: %u (expected: 1-8)", channels);
  }

  // Validate batch count
  (void)batch_count;

  // Validate size
  size_t expected_size = sizeof(audio_batch_packet_t) + (total_samples * sizeof(uint32_t));
  if (payload_len != expected_size) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "AUDIO_BATCH size mismatch");
  }

  // Extract quantized samples
  const uint8_t *samples_ptr = (const uint8_t *)payload + sizeof(audio_batch_packet_t);

  // Dequantize samples to float
  float *samples = SAFE_MALLOC(total_samples * sizeof(float), float *);
  if (!samples) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Failed to allocate audio batch buffer");
  }

  asciichat_error_t result = audio_dequantize_samples(samples_ptr, total_samples, samples);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    SAFE_FREE(samples);
    return result;
  }

  // Copy header for callback
  audio_batch_packet_t header_copy = *batch_header;
  header_copy.batch_count = batch_count;
  header_copy.total_samples = total_samples;
  header_copy.sample_rate = sample_rate;
  header_copy.channels = channels;

  callbacks->on_audio_batch(&header_copy, samples, total_samples, callbacks->app_ctx);

  SAFE_FREE(samples);
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

  // Ensure null-terminated message
  char msg_buffer[MAX_ERROR_MESSAGE_LENGTH + 1];

  memcpy(msg_buffer, message, copy_len);
  msg_buffer[copy_len] = '\0';

  callbacks->on_error(header, msg_buffer, callbacks->app_ctx);
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_handle_server_packet
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_handle_server_packet(acip_transport_t *transport, packet_type_t type, const void *payload,
                                            size_t payload_len, void *client_ctx,
                                            const acip_server_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  stats_runtime_packet(transport ? transport->stats_peer : NULL, type, payload_len, false, true);
  if (!transport || !callbacks) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid transport or callbacks");
  }
  (void)transport;

  // DEBUG: Log all packet types received
  log_dev("ACIP_HANDLE: type=%d payload_len=%zu", type, payload_len);

  // O(1) dispatch via hash table lookup
  int idx = handler_hash_lookup(g_server_handler_hash, type);
  if (idx < 0) {
    log_error("ACIP_HANDLER_NOT_FOUND: No handler for packet type=%d (0x%04x, name=%s)", type, type,
              g_packet_type_name(type));
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Unhandled server packet type: %d", type);
  }

  log_dev("HANDLER_DISPATCH: type=%d (%s), handler_idx=%d, payload=%zu bytes",
           type, g_packet_type_name(type), idx, payload_len);
  asciichat_error_t result = g_server_handlers[idx](payload, payload_len, client_ctx, callbacks);

  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    log_error("❌ [HANDLER_ERROR] Handler failed: type=%d (%s), result=%d", type, g_packet_type_name(type), result);
  } else {
    log_dev("HANDLER_COMPLETE: type=%d (%s), payload=%zu bytes", type,
             g_packet_type_name(type), payload_len);
  }

  return result;
}

functions.name: handle_server_image_frame
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t handle_server_image_frame(const void *payload, size_t payload_len, void *client_ctx,
                                                   const acip_server_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  log_dev("ACIP_IMAGE_FRAME_HANDLER: payload_len=%zu", payload_len);

  if (!callbacks->on_image_frame) {
    log_warn("ACIP_IMAGE_FRAME_HANDLER: No callback registered for on_image_frame");
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  log_dev("ACIP_IMAGE_FRAME_HANDLER: Callback registered (header=%zu)",
           sizeof(image_frame_packet_t));

  if (payload_len < sizeof(uint32_t) * 2) {
    log_error("ACIP_IMAGE_FRAME_HANDLER: Payload too small: %zu bytes (need at least 8)", payload_len);
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "IMAGE_FRAME payload too small: %zu bytes (need at least 8)", payload_len);
  }

  // Debug: Log raw payload bytes
  const uint8_t *payload_bytes = (const uint8_t *)payload;
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "IMAGE_FRAME payload (%zu bytes):", payload_len);
  char hex_buf[512];
  size_t hex_pos = 0;
  size_t max_bytes = (payload_len < 48) ? payload_len : 48;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < max_bytes && hex_pos < sizeof(hex_buf) - 4; i++) {
    hex_pos += snprintf(hex_buf + hex_pos, sizeof(hex_buf) - hex_pos, "%02x ", payload_bytes[i]);
  }
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "   First bytes: %s", hex_buf);

  // Older browser clients send [width:u32][height:u32][RGB24 pixels]. Accept
  // that exact size alongside the current image_frame_packet_t wire header.
  uint32_t legacy_width_net;
  uint32_t legacy_height_net;
  memcpy(&legacy_width_net, payload_bytes, sizeof(legacy_width_net));
  memcpy(&legacy_height_net, payload_bytes + sizeof(legacy_width_net), sizeof(legacy_height_net));
  uint32_t legacy_width = NET_TO_HOST_U32(legacy_width_net);
  uint32_t legacy_height = NET_TO_HOST_U32(legacy_height_net);
  size_t legacy_pixels = 0;
  size_t legacy_rgb_size = 0;
  size_t legacy_payload_size = 0;
  if (legacy_width > 0 && legacy_height > 0 && legacy_width <= 8192 && legacy_height <= 8192 &&
      checked_size_mul(legacy_width, legacy_height, &legacy_pixels) == ASCIICHAT_OK &&
      checked_size_mul(legacy_pixels, 3, &legacy_rgb_size) == ASCIICHAT_OK &&
      checked_size_add(sizeof(uint32_t) * 2, legacy_rgb_size, &legacy_payload_size) == ASCIICHAT_OK &&
      payload_len == legacy_payload_size) {
    image_frame_packet_t legacy_header = {0};
    legacy_header.width = legacy_width;
    legacy_header.height = legacy_height;
    legacy_header.pixel_format = 1; // RGB24
    callbacks->on_image_frame(&legacy_header, payload_bytes + sizeof(uint32_t) * 2, legacy_rgb_size, client_ctx,
                              callbacks->app_ctx);
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  if (payload_len < sizeof(image_frame_packet_t)) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "IMAGE_FRAME payload too small: %zu bytes (need %zu)", payload_len,
                     sizeof(image_frame_packet_t));
  }

  // Extract header
  image_frame_packet_t header;
  memcpy(&header, payload, sizeof(header));

  // Debug: Log raw header before byte order conversion
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "IMAGE_FRAME header (raw network order):");
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "   width=0x%08x height=0x%08x pixel_format=0x%08x compressed_size=0x%08x",
                header.width, header.height, header.pixel_format, header.compressed_size);

  // Convert from network byte order
  header.width = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.width);
  header.height = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.height);
  header.pixel_format = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.pixel_format);
  header.compressed_size = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.compressed_size);
  header.checksum = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.checksum);
  header.timestamp = NET_TO_HOST_U32(header.timestamp);

  // Debug: Log header after byte order conversion
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "IMAGE_FRAME header (after host byte order):");
  log_dev_every(4500 * US_PER_MS_INT, "   width=%u height=%u pixel_format=%u compressed_size=%u", header.width,
                header.height, header.pixel_format, header.compressed_size);

  // Get pixel data (after header)
  const void *pixel_data = (const uint8_t *)payload + sizeof(image_frame_packet_t);
  size_t pixel_data_len = payload_len - sizeof(image_frame_packet_t);

  // Validate frame dimensions to prevent DoS and buffer overflow attacks
  if (header.width == 0 || header.height == 0) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid image dimensions: %ux%u (width and height must be > 0)",
                     header.width, header.height);
  }

  // Sanity check: prevent unreasonably large frames (e.g., > 8K resolution for RGB)
  // This protects against resource exhaustion attacks
  const uint32_t MAX_WIDTH = 8192;  // 8K for RGB data
  const uint32_t MAX_HEIGHT = 8192; // 8K for RGB data
  if (header.width > MAX_WIDTH || header.height > MAX_HEIGHT) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Image dimensions too large: %ux%u (max: %ux%u)", header.width, header.height,
                     MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);
  }

  // Validate pixel format
  // Valid formats: RGB24 (3), RGBA32 (4), YUV420 (1.5)
  if (header.pixel_format == 0 || header.pixel_format > 4) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid pixel format: %u (expected: 1-4)", header.pixel_format);
  }

  log_dev(
      "📹 [IMAGE_FRAME_CALLBACK] Invoking on_image_frame callback: %ux%u pixels, format=%u, %zu bytes, client_ctx=%p",
      header.width, header.height, header.pixel_format, pixel_data_len, client_ctx);

  callbacks->on_image_frame(&header, pixel_data, pixel_data_len, client_ctx, callbacks->app_ctx);

  log_dev("IMAGE_FRAME_DONE");
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: handle_server_encoded_frame
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t handle_server_encoded_frame(const void *payload, size_t payload_len, void *client_ctx,
                                                     const acip_server_callbacks_t *callbacks, bool h264) {
  if (!payload || payload_len <= 5)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Encoded video payload must contain a five-byte header and access unit");
  const uint8_t *bytes = payload;
  uint8_t flags = bytes[0];
  uint16_t width = ((uint16_t)bytes[1] << 8) | bytes[2];
  uint16_t height = ((uint16_t)bytes[3] << 8) | bytes[4];
  if (!width || !height || width > 8192 || height > 8192 || (flags & ~3))
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid encoded video dimensions or flags");
  if (h264) {
    if (callbacks->on_image_frame_h264)
      callbacks->on_image_frame_h264(width, height, flags, bytes + 5, payload_len - 5, client_ctx, callbacks->app_ctx);
  } else if (callbacks->on_image_frame_h265) {
    callbacks->on_image_frame_h265(width, height, flags, bytes + 5, payload_len - 5, client_ctx, callbacks->app_ctx);
  }
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: handle_server_audio_batch
functions.snippetHtml:
static asciichat_error_t handle_server_audio_batch(const void *payload, size_t payload_len, void *client_ctx,
                                                   const acip_server_callbacks_t *callbacks) {
  if (!callbacks->on_audio_batch) {
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  }

  if (payload_len < sizeof(audio_batch_packet_t)) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "AUDIO_BATCH payload too small");
  }

  // Parse batch header
  const audio_batch_packet_t *batch_header = (const audio_batch_packet_t *)payload;
  uint32_t batch_count = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->batch_count);
  uint32_t total_samples = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->total_samples);
  uint32_t sample_rate = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->sample_rate);
  uint32_t channels = NET_TO_HOST_U32(batch_header->channels);

  // Validate size
  size_t expected_size = sizeof(audio_batch_packet_t) + (total_samples * sizeof(uint32_t));
  if (payload_len != expected_size) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "AUDIO_BATCH size mismatch");
  }

  // Extract quantized samples
  const uint8_t *samples_ptr = (const uint8_t *)payload + sizeof(audio_batch_packet_t);

  // Dequantize samples to float
  float *samples = SAFE_MALLOC(total_samples * sizeof(float), float *);
  if (!samples) {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Failed to allocate audio batch buffer");
  }

  asciichat_error_t result = audio_dequantize_samples(samples_ptr, total_samples, samples);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK) {
    SAFE_FREE(samples);
    return result;
  }

  // Copy header for callback
  audio_batch_packet_t header_copy = *batch_header;
  header_copy.batch_count = batch_count;
  header_copy.total_samples = total_samples;
  header_copy.sample_rate = sample_rate;
  header_copy.channels = channels;

  callbacks->on_audio_batch(&header_copy, samples, total_samples, client_ctx, callbacks->app_ctx);

  SAFE_FREE(samples);
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_packet_plan
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_packet_plan(crypto_context_t *crypto, const socket_buffer_t *buffers, size_t count,
                                   acip_packet_plan_t *plan) {
  if (!plan)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing ACIP packet plan");
  *plan = (acip_packet_plan_t){0};
  if (!buffers || !count || count > SOCKET_IOV_MAX)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid ACIP packet vectors");
  size_t size = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
    if ((buffers[i].len && !buffers[i].data) || buffers[i].len > SOCKET_SEND_BUFFER_MAX - size)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_SIZE, "Invalid ACIP packet vector size");
    size += buffers[i].len;
  }
  bool encrypt = false;
  buffer_domain_t *domain = NULL;
  if (buffers[0].len >= sizeof(packet_header_t)) {
    packet_header_t header;
    memcpy(&header, buffers[0].data, sizeof(header));
    packet_type_t type = NET_TO_HOST_U16(header.type);
    if (packet_is_handshake_type(type) || type == PACKET_TYPE_ERROR_MESSAGE)
      domain = buffer_control_domain();
    encrypt = crypto && crypto->encrypt_data && crypto_is_ready(crypto) &&
              !packet_is_handshake_type(NET_TO_HOST_U16(header.type));
  } else {
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing ACIP packet header");
  }
  size_t capacity = 0;
  if (encrypt) {
    if (size > CRYPTO_MAX_PLAINTEXT_SIZE ||
        size > SOCKET_SEND_BUFFER_MAX - sizeof(packet_header_t) - CRYPTO_NONCE_SIZE - CRYPTO_MAC_SIZE)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_SIZE, "Encrypted ACIP packet too large");
    capacity = size + CRYPTO_NONCE_SIZE + CRYPTO_MAC_SIZE;
  }
  *plan = (acip_packet_plan_t){buffers, count, size, capacity, encrypt, domain};
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

functions.name: acip_packet_encrypt
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_packet_encrypt(crypto_context_t *crypto, const acip_packet_plan_t *plan, buffer_domain_t *domain,
                                      void *ciphertext, size_t capacity, packet_header_t *header, size_t *length) {
  if (length)
    *length = 0;
  if (!crypto || !plan || !plan->encrypt || !plan->buffers || !plan->count || !ciphertext || !header || !length)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid ACIP encryption arguments");
  if (capacity < plan->ciphertext_capacity)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_SIZE, "ACIP ciphertext storage too small");
  const uint8_t *plaintext = plan->buffers[0].data;
  uint8_t *gathered = NULL;
  if (plan->count > 1) {
    gathered = buffer_alloc(domain, plan->plaintext_size);
    if (!gathered)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Cannot gather ACIP encryption input");
    size_t offset = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < plan->count; ++i) {
      if (plan->buffers[i].len)
        memcpy(gathered + offset, plan->buffers[i].data, plan->buffers[i].len);
      offset += plan->buffers[i].len;
    }
    plaintext = gathered;
  }
  size_t encrypted_length = 0;
  crypto_result_t result =
      crypto_encrypt(crypto, plaintext, plan->plaintext_size, ciphertext, capacity, &encrypted_length);
  buffer_release(gathered);
  if (result != CRYPTO_OK)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Cannot encrypt ACIP packet: %s", crypto_result_to_string(result));
  *header = (packet_header_t){.magic = HOST_TO_NET_U64(PACKET_MAGIC),
                              .type = HOST_TO_NET_U16(PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED),
                              .length = HOST_TO_NET_U32((uint32_t)encrypted_length),
                              .crc32 = HOST_TO_NET_U32(asciichat_crc32(ciphertext, encrypted_length)),
                              .client_id = 0};
  *length = encrypted_length;
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
}

void acip_security_cleanup(acip_security_t *security) {
  if (!security)
    return;
  SAFE_FREE(security->handshake.client_whitelist);
  crypto_handshake_destroy(&security->handshake);
}

functions.name: acip_security_start
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_security_start(acip_security_t *security, acip_transport_t *transport) {
  if (!security || !transport || security->mode > ACIP_CRYPTO_FULL ||
      security->handshake.state != CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_INIT)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_STATE, "Invalid peer security initialization");
  security->handshake.addressless_transport = true;
  transport->crypto_ctx = &security->handshake.crypto_ctx;
  security->handshake.crypto_ctx.encrypt_data = ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(security->mode);
  if (security->handshake.is_server)
    return ASCIICHAT_OK;
  protocol_version_packet_t version = {0};
  version.protocol_version = HOST_TO_NET_U16(1);
  version.supports_encryption = security->mode;
  return packet_send_via_transport(transport, PACKET_TYPE_PROTOCOL_VERSION, &version, sizeof(version), 0);
}

functions.name: acip_security_receive
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_security_receive(acip_security_t *security, acip_transport_t *transport, packet_type_t type,
                                        const void *payload, size_t length) {
  if (!security || !transport || (!payload && length) || security->ready)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_STATE, "Unexpected peer security packet");
  crypto_handshake_context_t *ctx = &security->handshake;
  asciichat_error_t result = ASCIICHAT_OK;
  if (!security->version_received) {
    if (type != PACKET_TYPE_PROTOCOL_VERSION || length != sizeof(protocol_version_packet_t))
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Expected peer security negotiation before media");
    protocol_version_packet_t version;
    memcpy(&version, payload, sizeof(version));
    uint8_t mode = version.supports_encryption;
    if (NET_TO_HOST_U16(version.protocol_version) != 1 || mode > ACIP_CRYPTO_FULL)
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Unsupported peer security protocol");
    if (ctx->is_server) {
      // Match secure WebSocket policy: defaults do not override a client's explicit no-encrypt.
      if ((ctx->has_password || ctx->require_client_auth) && !ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_AUTH(mode))
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO_AUTH, "Peer omitted required authentication");
      if (security->require_encryption && !ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(mode))
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Peer omitted required encryption");
      if (security->forbid_encryption && ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(mode))
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Peer requires encryption but local policy disables it");
      version.supports_encryption = mode;
      result = packet_send_via_transport(transport, PACKET_TYPE_PROTOCOL_VERSION, &version, sizeof(version), 0);
      if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
        return result;
    } else if ((mode & security->mode) != security->mode) {
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Peer attempted to downgrade requested security");
    }
    if (security->forbid_encryption && ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(mode))
      return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Peer requires encryption but local policy disables it");
    security->mode = mode;
    security->version_received = true;
    ctx->crypto_ctx.encrypt_data = ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(mode);
    if (mode == ACIP_CRYPTO_NONE) {
      ctx->state = CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_DISABLED;
      security->ready = true;
      return ASCIICHAT_OK;
    }
    if (!ctx->is_server)
      return ASCIICHAT_OK;
    result = crypto_handshake_server_send_parameters(ctx, transport);
    if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK)
      result = crypto_handshake_server_start(ctx, transport);
    return result;
  }
  if (ctx->is_server) {
    if (ctx->state == CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_KEY_EXCHANGE)
      result = crypto_handshake_server_auth_challenge(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
    else if (ctx->state == CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_AUTHENTICATING)
      result = crypto_handshake_server_complete(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
    else
      result = SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Unexpected peer authentication state");
  } else {
    switch (type) {
    case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_PARAMETERS:
      if (security->parameters_received || ctx->state != CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_INIT ||
          length != sizeof(crypto_parameters_packet_t))
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Invalid peer crypto parameters");
      result = crypto_handshake_set_parameters(ctx, payload);
      if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK && ctx->crypto_ctx.encrypt_data != !!ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(security->mode))
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Peer cipher does not match negotiated policy");
      security->parameters_received = result == ASCIICHAT_OK;
      break;
    case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_KEY_EXCHANGE_INIT:
      if (!security->parameters_received)
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Missing peer crypto parameters");
      if (ctx->verify_server_key && length == ctx->crypto_ctx.public_key_size)
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO_AUTH, "Peer omitted the required identity key");
      result = crypto_handshake_client_key_exchange(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
      break;
    case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_AUTH_CHALLENGE:
      result = crypto_handshake_client_auth_response(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
      break;
    case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_COMPLETE:
      if (ctx->has_password || ctx->client_private_key.type == KEY_TYPE_ED25519)
        return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO_AUTH, "Peer skipped required mutual authentication");
      result = crypto_handshake_client_complete(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
      break;
    case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_SERVER_AUTH_RESP:
    case PACKET_TYPE_CRYPTO_AUTH_FAILED:
      result = crypto_handshake_client_complete(ctx, transport, type, payload, length);
      break;
    default:
      result = SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Application packet before peer authentication");
    }
  }
  if (result == ASCIICHAT_OK)
    security->ready = ctx->state == CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_READY;
  else
    ctx->state = CRYPTO_HANDSHAKE_FAILED;
  return result;
}

functions.name: acip_security_init_options
functions.snippetHtml:
asciichat_error_t acip_security_init_options(acip_security_t *security, bool server) {
  if (!security)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Missing peer security state");
  memset(security, 0, sizeof(*security));
  const options_t *options = options_get();
  if (!options)
    return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_STATE, "Peer security requires initialized options");
  crypto_policy_t policy = {
      .transport_secure = true,
      .encrypt = options->encrypt_enabled,
      .no_encrypt = options->no_encrypt,
      .no_auth = options->no_auth,
      .has_password = options->password[0] != '\0',
      .has_identity = options->encrypt_key[0] != '\0',
      .has_verification_key = server ? options->client_keys[0] != '\0' : options->server_key[0] != '\0',
  };
  asciichat_error_t result = crypto_policy_resolve(&policy, &security->mode);
  security->forbid_encryption = policy.no_encrypt;
  security->require_encryption = policy.encrypt;
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    return result;
  crypto_handshake_context_t *ctx = &security->handshake;
  result = policy.has_password ? crypto_handshake_init_with_password("webrtc_peer", ctx, server, options->password)
                               : crypto_handshake_init("webrtc_peer", ctx, server);
  if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
    return result;
  ctx->require_client_auth = server && options->require_server_verify;
  ctx->crypto_ctx.encrypt_data = ACIP_CRYPTO_HAS_ENCRYPT(security->mode);
  if (policy.has_identity) {
    private_key_t *private_key = server ? &ctx->server_private_key : &ctx->client_private_key;
    public_key_t *public_key = server ? &ctx->server_public_key : &ctx->client_public_key;
    result = parse_private_key(options->encrypt_key, private_key);
    if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
      goto failed;
    public_key->type = KEY_TYPE_ED25519;
    memcpy(public_key->key, private_key->public_key, ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_SIZE);
    if (!server && strncmp(options->encrypt_key, "gpg:", 4) == 0)
      SAFE_STRNCPY(ctx->client_gpg_key_id, options->encrypt_key + 4, sizeof(ctx->client_gpg_key_id));
  }
  if (server && policy.has_verification_key) {
    ctx->client_whitelist = SAFE_CALLOC(MAX_CLIENTS, sizeof(public_key_t), public_key_t *);
    if (!ctx->client_whitelist) {
      result = SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Cannot allocate WebRTC client key list");
      goto failed;
    }
    result = parse_public_keys(options->client_keys, ctx->client_whitelist, &ctx->num_whitelisted_clients, MAX_CLIENTS);
    if (result != ASCIICHAT_OK)
      goto failed;
    if (!ctx->num_whitelisted_clients) {
      result = SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO_AUTH, "WebRTC client key list is empty");
      goto failed;
    }
    ctx->require_client_auth = true;
  } else if (!server && policy.has_verification_key) {
    ctx->verify_server_key = true;
    SAFE_STRNCPY(ctx->expected_server_key, options->server_key, sizeof(ctx->expected_server_key));
    SAFE_STRNCPY(ctx->server_hostname, options->session_string, sizeof(ctx->server_hostname));
  }
  return ASCIICHAT_OK;
failed:
  acip_security_cleanup(security);
  return result;
}
